gen-dafont-eraser-fs-asap: Asap reads clearly, its c forms curving like open arcs and its lowercase nearly capital height. Eraser, meanwhile, lays down bold letters with pencil-line consistency and no thicker or thinner strokes.
gen-dafont-eraser-fs-public-sans: Understated but commanding, Eraser gives every letter a smooth, tube-like line. Eraser handles the announcing in bold, uniform strokes, while Public Sans carries the reading with a hefty lowercase and broad counters.
gen-dafont-eraser-manrope: Eraser lays down bold strokes that never thicken or thin. Manrope then reads approachable and clean, its curves opening brightly and its lowercase sitting close to the capitals, so paragraphs keep moving.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-bespoke-sans: Fast and aggressive, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart. Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined, with generous space between curve ends and stems that lets whole paragraphs flow along without snagging.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-glegoo: Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart with short ascenders over big bowls, fast and aggressive from the first glance. Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its wide-mouthed curves easing the way.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-piazzolla: Ethnocentric is fast and aggressive, pushing its letters well apart. Piazzolla brings the authority, with a lowercase nearly matching the capitals and an e opened like a pried clasp.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, with open, pincer-like c shapes. Ethnocentric is built for the fast, aggressive shout, while Instrument Sans holds its stroke weight steady for everything that follows.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-inter: Wide-spaced letters with short ascenders over big bowls give Ethnocentric its fast, aggressive look. Inter keeps a smooth, tube-like line and big counters in a tall lowercase, with no hairlines anywhere.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-mulish: Pushed-apart letters give Ethnocentric a fast, aggressive stance, short ascenders perched above big bowls. Mulish counters with a modern, approachable ease, its horseshoe-like apertures cut at a single depth.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-ovo: Industrial and modern, Existence carries wide, porthole-like counters and terminals cut short of the bowl. And Ovo, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals, keeps paragraphs moving at a classic, authoritative pace.
